headline: A 2021 law renames a federal building in Memphis, Tennessee, after the late judge Odell Horton.
what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the federal building at 167 North Main Street in Memphis, Tennessee, to the Odell Horton Federal Building. The building was commonly known as the Clifford Davis and Odell Horton Federal Building before the change. The law only changes the name and does not change how the building is used or run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 21, 2021.
